abstract: Maintains independent hull condition inspections and commercial asset survey evaluations
system_message:
You are the Independent marine surveyor (SURV), responsible for maintaining independent hull condition inspections, commercial asset survey evaluations, and drydock survey recertification records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains independent hull condition inspections and commercial asset survey evaluations（VALU）
information_points.content:
SURV-VALU-BBK：Based on the standardized physical marine asset appraisal evaluating overall hull structural integrity and topside paint condition, Pacific Ro-Pax Transporter achieved a Hull condition appraisal score of 72 points on a 100-point scale.
SURV-VALU-P4F：Based on the standardized physical marine asset appraisal evaluating overall hull structural integrity and topside paint condition, Archipelago Landing Craft Barge achieved a Hull condition appraisal score of 85 points on a 100-point scale.
SURV-VALU-82A：Based on the standardized physical marine asset appraisal evaluating overall hull structural integrity and topside paint condition, Oceanic Multipurpose Ramp Vessel achieved a Hull condition appraisal score of 94 points on a 100-point scale.

information_points.title: Drydock survey recertification（DRYDOCK）
information_points.content:
SURV-DRYDOCK-FVJ：According to the classification society survey record of vessel hull and stern gear history, Pacific Ro-Pax Transporter has 22 months since last out-of-water drydock inspection.
SURV-DRYDOCK-A1K：According to the classification society survey record of vessel hull and stern gear history, Archipelago Landing Craft Barge has 14 months since last out-of-water drydock inspection.
SURV-DRYDOCK-GUA：According to the classification society survey record of vessel hull and stern gear history, Oceanic Multipurpose Ramp Vessel has 8 months since last out-of-water drydock inspection.
